series.title: Oakhaven Adventures

questGiver.name: Soren Vale
questGiver.why: The people on the span are his watch. His slate hires the party at the east gate because he cannot leave them.

series.mayorFrame: Only level 1 and level 10 are the mayor's quests. This module's giver is the NPC in questGiver. Do not move this job onto the mayor's desk.

setup.pitch: The Night Spring traced from the Black Orchard resurfaces beneath the Ashen Bridge just as a merchant caravan is caught on the failing span.
setup.openingLocation: East road approach to the Ashen Bridge
setup.gmSummary: The party reaches the Ashen Bridge during a blackwater surge. Six civilians and two wagons are trapped on the center span while Bridgewarden Soren Vale tries to hold a cracked pier together. The old bridge was designed with ashwood drainage ribs that neutralized seepage from the Night Spring, but recent emergency repairs replaced three ribs with iron braces. The water is now eroding the pier instead of being wicked into ash beds. The party must reach the bridge ashhouse, mix a sealing mortar, then manage a live evacuation while installing the seal. The best ending saves the people and bridge. A hard rescue can save everyone while losing the bridge. Greedy delay can cost cargo or lives. Pace: the gate slate, a rolled encounter outside town, the false west ford, a second roll on the last mile, arrival on the span with the caustic trap and ash-mortar puzzle, the rescue under Soren's count, the return to the gate, and the Mere lead.
setup.background: For generations the Ashen Bridge carried Oakhaven's east road across the Merecut gorge. Its blackened ashwood ribs were not ornamental: they drew tainted groundwater into sacrificial ash beds beneath the eastern pier. After spring floods damaged the bridge, cash-strapped road crews replaced three ash ribs with iron. The change went unnoticed until the Night Spring intensified. Now blackwater pressure is undermining the eastern pier while a caravan is stranded above it.
setup.standaloneStart: If prior Oakhaven modules were not played, Bridgewarden Soren sends a runner to Oakhaven when black water begins boiling from the eastern pier and the center span cracks under a trapped caravan.
setup.characterPressure: Soren Vale wants every civilian off the bridge before his ignored warning kills someone; Mera Holt will sacrifice both wagons without hesitation if that buys a safer rescue.

quest.objective: Rescue the six trapped civilians, stabilize or abandon the Ashen Bridge, and stop the Night Spring surge from undermining the eastern road.
quest.stakes: Every failed rescue cycle damages the bridge. If integrity reaches 0 before the civilians are off, people can fall with the span.
quest.deadline: BRIDGE INTEGRITY 4→0. Lose 1 integrity at the end of each finale round while the pier is unsealed. Lose an extra 1 if a wagon remains on the center span when a Pressure Break occurs.
successConditions: All six civilians are off the center span.
The Night Spring surge is sealed or the collapsing span is deliberately abandoned.
failureConditions: Bridge Integrity reaches 0 while civilians remain on the center span.
The party leaves without attempting the evacuation.

facts.text: The bridge's original ashwood ribs neutralized tainted groundwater by drawing it into sacrificial ash beds.
Three ash ribs were replaced with iron braces, breaking the bridge's old filtration function.
An ash-lime sealing mortar can restore the eastern pier long enough for the bridge to survive the Night Spring surge.
The trapped wagons are accelerating structural damage; dumping cargo or moving wagons reduces risk.
The Night Spring does not end at the bridge; underground soundings continue toward a flooded bell chamber beneath the Mere.

secrets.text: The town council approved the iron repair as a cheaper substitute despite Soren's written objection.
secrets.revealCondition: Read the ashhouse maintenance ledger or earn Soren's trust after the rescue.

npcs.name: Soren Vale
wants: The eastern pier sealed before the bridge is lost
fears: His ignored repair warnings becoming a death sentence
knows: The ashhouse stores lime and char ash
The center span can survive briefly if wagon load is reduced
believes: The bridge can still be saved if the party reaches the ashhouse first
secrets: He warned against the iron braces in writing and was overruled
cannotKnow: Where the Night Spring goes beyond the bridge soundings

revealRules.fact: Dumping wagon cargo buys structural time.
revealRules.when: The party asks what can reduce the load immediately.

revealRules.fact: The ashhouse mortar can seal the pier.
revealRules.when: The party asks how to save the bridge rather than simply evacuate.

npcs.questFunction: Provides the rescue priorities, makes the bridge mechanics legible, and keeps the finale focused on lives and structure.
npcs.description: A lean bridgewarden in a soaked leather coat, one sleeve tied above a splinted forearm, chalking new cracks onto a board faster than the rain can wash them away.
tableDialogue: “Six people. Two wagons. Four good breaths left in this bridge if the pier keeps taking water.”
“Save the people first. If you can save the bridge too, I will not stop you.”
“The old ash ribs drank this poison. Iron only gives it something hard to push against.”

reactions.agreement: Hands over the ashhouse key and a coil of bridge line.
reactions.refusal: Begins evacuating alone; the party can still join at any point.
reactions.danger: Cuts loose a cargo wagon before risking another civilian.
reactions.accusation: Accepts blame for not stopping the iron-brace retrofit, then shows the written warning he filed before the work was approved.

npcs.name: Mera Holt
npcs.role: caravan master trapped on the center span
wants: At least one wagon saved if it does not risk lives
fears: Panicked horses pulling a wagon sideways
Being blamed for blocking the bridge
knows: One wagon carries stone and is dangerously heavy
The lighter medicine wagon can be pushed by hand if the horses are cut loose
believes: The eastern rail will fail before the road deck

revealRules.fact: The stone wagon can be dumped in one Action by cutting its rear pins.

npcs.questFunction: Turns abstract civilians into named rescue stakes and presents the cargo-vs-life choice without hiding mechanics.
npcs.description: A broad-faced caravan master with rain plastering gray hair to her cheeks, braced between two wagons while keeping four frightened travelers low behind the wheel hubs.
tableDialogue: “People first. Then medicine. Stone can learn to swim.”
“Cut the rear pins and the heavy wagon dumps straight off the east side.”
“Do not make my people run until someone has that guide rope tight.”

reactions.agreement: Organizes civilians into pairs, giving advantage to the first guided crossing check.
reactions.refusal: Moves her people anyway once a safe line is visible.
reactions.danger: Cuts the heavy wagon loose herself if the bridge loses two integrity.
reactions.accusation: Admits the stone wagon is worsening the load and says she will dump it herself if the party will not risk an Action on it.

locations.name: West Bridge Approach
locations.description: Rain lashes the east road where old stone meets a timber span shuddering over black floodwater. The air smells of wet rope and split pine, and every deep impact from the gorge travels up through the milestone underfoot.

locations.name: Bridge Ashhouse
locations.description: A low maintenance shed crouches beside the road, warm with the chalky bite of slaked lime and wet charcoal. Ash barrels, spare rope, old rib templates, and a mixing trough crowd the walls, with one door back to the approach and another opening toward the center span.

locations.name: Center Span
locations.description: Two wagons and six soaked travelers crowd a cracked timber deck above a gorge where blackwater hammers the eastern pier. Boards flex under shifting weight, wagon wheels grind against chocks, and the west approach remains the only clear route to solid ground.

locations.name: Eastern Pier
locations.description: The eastern stone pier is split along three iron braces while black water jets from joints that once held sacrificial ashwood ribs. Spray makes the footing slick, the braces ring under pressure, and a narrow maintenance ledge gives access to the failing seams.

locations.name: Oakhaven east gate
locations.description: The east gate is oak, iron strap, and a bench that always holds one wet cloak. Beyond it the Merecut road runs straight until the gorge. Tonight the bench holds a runner's satchel and the cloak is Soren Vale's spare, still dripping black water.

scenes.title: Six People, Two Wagons
scenes.purpose: Hook the party at Oakhaven's gate: the Ashen Bridge is failing with people on it.
scenes.readAloud: The east gate is open and the bench is wet. A runner's satchel holds Bridgewarden Soren Vale's spare cloak and a slate that has been written fast: six people, two wagons, center span, black water in the pier. The runner is gone back to the gorge. The gate sergeant will not leave the gate. She pushes the slate into your hands and says the bridge has four good breaths left, which is Soren's count, not hers.
gmNotes: Soren is on the bridge, not here. The slate is the hook if he is later dead or unreachable.
Saving the people is success even if the bridge is lost. Say that before they leave.
Red herring waiting on the road: a rumor that the west ford is the safer crossing. It is not. The people are already on the span.

runSteps.title: Read the slate
runSteps.text: Six people. Two wagons. Four breaths in Soren's count. Integrity clock starts at 4 when they can see the bridge, not now.

runSteps.title: Say the value
runSteps.text: People count as the victory. The bridge is the second prize.

runSteps.title: Do not wait for the sergeant
runSteps.text: She stays. The adventure does not need her to live or to like them.

scenes.advanceWhen: The party is on the east road with the slate.

scenes.title: Six People on a Bad Bridge
scenes.purpose: Make the rescue count, bridge clock, and two viable priorities immediately visible.
scenes.readAloud: The Ashen Bridge moves when the wind does not. Six people crouch between two wagons on the center span while black water punches through the eastern pier below them. A bridgewarden with one arm splinted is tying rope around a milestone. He sees you and shouts over the rain. “Six people. Two wagons. Four good breaths left in the bridge.”
gmNotes: Put four BRIDGE INTEGRITY boxes on the table. The live countdown begins only when the finale starts; the party has time to reach the ashhouse first.
Soren presents two jobs: prepare the ash-lime seal, then evacuate the caravan while installing it.
The heavy stone wagon is structurally dangerous. Dumping its cargo later prevents the extra wagon penalty.
The party can choose a pure evacuation plan and let the bridge fall; saving the bridge is optional.

runSteps.title: Count the lives
runSteps.text: State six civilians and two wagons clearly.

runSteps.title: Show four integrity
runSteps.text: Place four visible bridge boxes; tell players they do not start ticking until the rescue sequence begins.

runSteps.title: Offer the ashhouse
runSteps.text: Soren says the old maintenance shed may contain what is needed to seal the eastern pier.

scenes.advanceWhen: The party commits to the rescue and either heads for the ashhouse or proceeds directly to the span.

exitChoices.label: Prepare the seal
exitChoices.description: Check the ashhouse before beginning the live bridge evacuation.

scenes.title: Three Measures Black
scenes.purpose: Teach the bridge's original function and create the sealing material through a quick tactile puzzle.
scenes.readAloud: The ashhouse smells of wet charcoal and lime. Three marked scoops hang above a stone trough: one white, one black, one plain wood. A bridge rib template is burned with a maintenance verse: TWO WHITE TO BIND, ONE BLACK TO DRINK, WATER UNTIL THE TROUGH STANDS STILL. On the back wall, old drawings show ashwood ribs feeding into beds beneath the eastern pier.
gmNotes: Correct mortar: 2 measures lime, 1 measure char ash, then water.
A wrong dry ratio causes Caustic Puff: DC 12 Constitution save or 1d6 poison damage. Ingredients remain available.
After one wrong ratio, old scoop wear clearly shows two white marks and one black mark; failure cannot block progress.
Mixing the seal reveals the original ash-rib filtration design and the later iron substitution.
Prepared Seal grants one automatic successful Pier Seal action during the finale; without it, the pier can still be sealed with two DC 13 repair successes using improvised material.

runSteps.title: Present the verse
runSteps.text: Read the 2-white / 1-black / water clue exactly once and let players handle the three scoops.

runSteps.title: Fail forward
runSteps.text: On a wrong ratio, resolve Caustic Puff and reveal the scoop wear marks.

runSteps.title: Package the payoff
runSteps.text: The finished ash-lime mortar counts as one automatic Pier Seal success in the finale.

scenes.advanceWhen: The ash-lime seal is mixed or the party deliberately leaves without it.

exitChoices.label: Begin the evacuation
exitChoices.description: Carry the prepared seal and bridge line onto the live span.

scenes.title: The Bridge Moves Under You
scenes.purpose: Introduce bridge movement, optional blackwater predators, and let the party set the guide line before the full timed finale.
scenes.readAloud: The center span drops half an inch under your first steps. One wagon is stacked with cut stone; the other carries medicine crates under soaked canvas. Six travelers cling to spokes and rail posts. Below, something long and pale rolls through the blackwater, then vanishes beneath the eastern pier. Mera Holt points at the heavy wagon. “Stone can swim. People cannot.”
gmNotes: This scene is positioning, not yet the integrity clock.
Two Blackwater Lampreys may climb the east rail if the party spends time there. They are nuisance threats and can be driven back with damage or a DC 12 Strength shove.

Set Guide Line: one character can use an Action and DC 12 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) or Strength (Athletics) to secure Soren's rope across the span. Success gives advantage on all civilian crossing checks in the finale.
Dump Heavy Cargo: one Action adjacent to the stone wagon cuts rear pins and removes the extra-wagon integrity penalty for the finale.
Mera grants advantage to the first civilian crossing check once the finale begins.

runSteps.title: Show the load problem
runSteps.text: Identify the heavy stone wagon and medicine wagon.

runSteps.title: Let them prepare
runSteps.text: Allow the guide line and cargo dump before the clock starts.

runSteps.title: Start when they are ready
runSteps.text: The integrity clock begins when the party declares the evacuation underway or starts sealing the eastern pier.

scenes.advanceWhen: The party starts the evacuation/sealing sequence.

exitChoices.label: Start the bridge rescue
exitChoices.description: Begin timed evacuation and pier sealing.

scenes.title: Four Integrity
scenes.purpose: Run a transparent rescue clock where characters choose each round between moving people, reducing load, defending, and sealing the pier.
scenes.readAloud: The bridge gives a deep wooden crack and the eastern pier shifts sideways. Blackwater sprays through the iron braces in three hard jets. Behind you, six people wait for someone to tell them when to move. Ahead, the pier is close enough to reach with a rope and the ash-lime seal. Soren raises four fingers from the west bank. One folds down as another crack races through the deck.
gmNotes: Start Bridge Integrity at 4 and civiliansRemaining at 6.
At the end of each round while pierSeal is false, lose 1 Bridge Integrity.

Pressure Break at initiative count 20: creatures on the center/east span make DC 12 Dexterity saves or fall Prone. If the heavy stone wagon still carries its cargo, also lose 1 additional Integrity on the first Pressure Break only.
Guide Civilians: Action, DC 12 Charisma (Persuasion), Wisdom (Survival), or Dexterity (Acrobatics) to move 2 civilians safely to the west bank; move only 1 on a failure. Guide Line gives advantage.
Move Medicine Wagon: two adjacent characters each spend an Action to push it west; saving it grants extra reward but is never required.
Pier Seal with prepared mortar: one Action adjacent to the eastern pier automatically seals it.
Pier Seal without prepared mortar: require 2 total DC 13 successes using Strength (Athletics), Intelligence (Nature), or Dexterity with suitable tools; one success can be accumulated across rounds.
Once pierSeal is true, Integrity stops decreasing at round end.

If Integrity reaches 0 with civilians still present, each remaining civilian makes a DC 10 Dexterity save; failed saves create a hanging rescue target rather than instant death. Each hanging target can be pulled up with one Action and DC 11 Athletics before the scene resolves.
The bridge may be abandoned deliberately once all civilians are safe; that is a valid full rescue even if the structure is lost.

runSteps.title: Show the board
runSteps.text: Track Integrity 4, Civilians 6, Heavy Cargo present/removed, Medicine Wagon present/removed, and Pier Seal yes/no.

runSteps.title: Run Pressure Break
runSteps.text: At initiative 20, resolve prone risk and the one-time heavy-wagon integrity penalty if still loaded.

runSteps.title: Let actions compete
runSteps.text: Every Action spent sealing, rescuing, pushing, or defending matters; do not add hidden penalties.

runSteps.title: Stop the clock honestly
runSteps.text: Once Pier Seal succeeds, no more automatic integrity loss. Once all civilians are safe, the party may abandon the bridge without further checks.

scenes.advanceWhen: All civilians are safe and either the pier is sealed or the bridge has been deliberately abandoned/collapsed.

exitChoices.label: People and bridge saved
exitChoices.description: All civilians safe, pier sealed, Bridge Integrity remains above 0.

exitChoices.label: People saved, bridge lost
exitChoices.description: All civilians safe but the span collapses or is deliberately abandoned.

exitChoices.label: Rescue with injuries
exitChoices.description: Integrity reaches 0 while civilians remain and the party completes hanging rescues.

scenes.title: Resolution: The Road Holds
scenes.purpose: Reward a complete rescue and stabilized crossing.
scenes.readAloud: The ash-lime seal turns gray as it sets against the eastern pier. For the first time since you arrived, the bridge stops moving. One by one the rescued travelers step off the west approach and onto solid road. Behind them, blackwater still runs through the gorge, but no longer through the bridge. Soren lays a hand on the old ashwood rail. “It remembers what it was built to do.”
gmNotes: Award 125 gp total.
If the medicine wagon was saved, Mera adds a Healer's Satchel with two Potion of Healing uses represented as two separate doses.
Soren's soundings show the Night Spring continuing southeast toward a flooded bell chamber beneath the Mere.
The Ashen Bridge remains open after repairs.

runSteps.title: Pay the rescue
runSteps.text: Award 125 gp total.

runSteps.title: Reward extra rescue
runSteps.text: If the medicine wagon survived, award two healing-potion doses.

runSteps.title: Open Module 06
runSteps.text: Reveal the flooded bell chamber beneath the Mere.

scenes.advanceWhen: Rewards are recorded and the Mere lead is understood.

exitChoices.label: Return to the gate
exitChoices.description: Go back to Oakhaven and settle the job.

scenes.title: Resolution: People Before Timber
scenes.purpose: Treat a full civilian rescue as success even when the structure is sacrificed.
scenes.readAloud: The last traveler reaches stone just before the center span folds into the gorge. Wet timber disappears beneath blackwater and the medicine wagon tips after it with a flash of canvas. Nobody follows. Soren watches the bridge go without speaking, then looks over the six soaked people beside you. “Roads can be rebuilt.”
gmNotes: Award 100 gp total for saving all six civilians.
The bridge is closed until rebuilt, slowing travel east of Oakhaven.
If the medicine wagon was saved before collapse, Mera still awards two healing-potion doses.
The Night Spring remains active downstream toward the Mere.

runSteps.title: Count six survivors
runSteps.text: Make the full civilian rescue explicit.

runSteps.title: Record infrastructure loss
runSteps.text: The Ashen Bridge is destroyed or unusable.

runSteps.title: Point downstream
runSteps.text: Soren's surviving soundings lead to the flooded bell chamber beneath the Mere.

scenes.advanceWhen: The rescue count and bridge loss are recorded.

exitChoices.label: Return to the gate
exitChoices.description: Go back to Oakhaven and settle the job.

scenes.title: Resolution: Hands on the Rope
scenes.purpose: Allow the adventure to finish after a clock failure while preserving consequence and heroic recovery.
scenes.readAloud: The span breaks before everyone is clear. For several terrible seconds the bridge is rope, splintered rail, and people shouting each other's names over blackwater. Then the last pair of hands clears the edge. The bridge is gone. Nobody pretends it was clean. But everyone you pulled from the gorge is still breathing when the rain begins to ease.
gmNotes: Award 75 gp total.
Any civilian who failed the collapse save is injured but alive if the party completed the hanging rescue.
The bridge is destroyed.
Mera does not award the medicine bonus unless that wagon was explicitly moved before collapse.
The Mere lead remains available from Soren's records.

runSteps.title: Record injuries
runSteps.text: Note which civilians were pulled from the collapse; they survive but may need care.

runSteps.title: Apply reduced reward
runSteps.text: Award 75 gp total.

runSteps.title: Keep the chain moving
runSteps.text: Reveal the flooded bell chamber beneath the Mere.

scenes.advanceWhen: Survivors and injuries are recorded and the party has the Mere lead.

exitChoices.label: Return to the gate
exitChoices.description: Go back to Oakhaven and settle the job.

scenes.title: Roll outside the Gate
scenes.purpose: A rolled encounter just outside Oakhaven, before the bridge's real direction is tested.
scenes.readAloud: Outside the gate the east road is a pale track under a dark sky. Rain has started in the gorge and not here, which makes the dust look like a lie. A mile-post offers the bridge and, in newer chalk, a west ford. Somebody wants the traffic to turn around. Roll before you let them choose.
gmNotes: Roll 1d6 in the open. Use that row only. This is not a fixed fight.
The row never carries the only copy of a required clue. Skipping it does not stop the night.

1. A merchant turning back says the ford is safe and the bridge is already gone. He has not seen either. DC 10 Wisdom (Insight): he is repeating a shout. The slate in their hands is newer than his story.
2. A loose dog with a bridgewarden's whistle on its collar. It will lead toward the gorge, not the ford, if anyone DC 10 Wisdom (Animal Handling) or simply follows. Failure: it goes anyway.
3. Wind knocks a sign down. DC 10 Strength (Athletics) resets it. The sign's carved face still says ASHEN BRIDGE. The chalk ford arrow is on a separate board.

4. Hungry SRD Black Bear, not a required fight. AC 11, HP 19. 2014: Bite +3 (1d6+2) and Claws +3 (2d4+2). 2024: two Rend attacks +4, 1d6+2 slashing each. Offer food or a DC 15 Wisdom (Animal Handling) check. Success: it leaves. Failure: it snaps once, then the party can still go around. Do not spend the night here.
5. A child selling bad luck charms for 1 cp. No magic. If they buy one, it does nothing. Say so.
6. DC 10 Dexterity (Acrobatics) around a mud slick. Failure: Prone, clothes wet, no damage, and they are still on the east road.

exitChoices.label: Hear the ford rumor
exitChoices.description: The rolled row is done and the road continues.

runSteps.title: Roll in the open
runSteps.text: Tell the table this beat is a roll, not a scripted monster. Roll 1d6 where everyone can see it.

runSteps.title: Run only that row
runSteps.text: Read the matching row. If it is the combat row, offer the listed way out before initiative.

runSteps.title: Move on either way
runSteps.text: Success and failure both leave the party able to continue. Do not gate the next scene on this roll.

scenes.advanceWhen: One rolled row has been resolved and the party is moving again.

scenes.title: The Ford Is the Lie
scenes.purpose: Make the gorge the clear destination and kill the west-ford red herring.
scenes.readAloud: The mile-post outside the gate has been recruited by two different stories. Fresh chalk sends traffic to a west ford and calls the bridge already gone. Under the chalk, older letters cut into the wood say ASHEN BRIDGE, ONE MILE. A merchant with a turned wagon wants company if you go west. A wet bootprint over the chalk points east, and from that direction comes one wooden crack too large to be a branch. Soren's slate, still in your hand, says the people are on the span.
gmNotes: Quest giver is Bridgewarden Soren Vale. He is on the bridge. The slate at the east gate is how the job reaches the party if he is later dead or out of reach. The gate sergeant only passes the slate. The mayor does not give this job.

Lead A, red herring: the west ford. Motive: the merchant already turned his wagon around and does not want to be the only one who ran. He has not seen the span. The ford is a flooded ditch. Checking it costs about ten minutes.
Lead B: the chalk itself. Motive of whoever wrote it is panic, not a second bridge. It smears. The carved letters do not.
Lead C, physical: Soren's slate and the bootprint both point east. The crack is audible from the true road. Saving the people still counts if the bridge is lost. Say that before they commit.
Let them question the merchant and test the ford. The slate does not stop being true while they do.

exitChoices.label: Run for the gorge
exitChoices.description: Roll once on the last mile.

runSteps.title: Put the leads on the table
runSteps.text: Name the people and the physical claims. Let the players choose the order. Do not announce which one is true.

runSteps.title: Play the motive
runSteps.text: Each person wants something. A false lead has a reason. Answer questions in that person's voice.

runSteps.title: Wrong turns fail forward
runSteps.text: Checking the red herring costs about ten minutes. The true route is still in their hands afterward, on paper or on the ground.

scenes.advanceWhen: The party is committed to the gorge road.

scenes.title: Roll on the Last Mile
scenes.purpose: A rolled encounter while traveling to the Ashen Bridge.
scenes.readAloud: The last mile smells of wet ash and cold iron. The gorge opens as a darker cut in the rain. You can hear people and you cannot see them yet. The road underfoot shifts once, not enough to be the bridge and enough to be a warning. Roll before the span comes into view.
gmNotes: Roll 1d6 in the open. Use that row only. This is not a fixed fight.
The row never carries the only copy of a required clue. Skipping it does not stop the night.
1. A dropped medicine crate, two Potion of Healing doses (SRD, 2d4+2). Taking them is allowed. They are consumable. The wagon on the bridge may still hold more.
2. DC 10 Strength (Athletics) to drag a fallen limb out of the lane. Failure: climb over, arrive muddy, no damage.
3. A shout from the gorge: “Six!” It is Mera Holt counting heads. They do not need to answer for her to still be there.
4. One SRD Giant Constrictor Snake in the ditch, if they attack the water. Otherwise it stays down. See the lamprey block for the 2024 bite and constrict. Do not add it to the span count.
5. Ash on the wind. DC 15 Intelligence (Nature): this is the bridge's own ashwood, already failing. Failure: Soren can say it on the span.
6. DC 10 Dexterity (Acrobatics) on the wet camber. Failure: Prone. The bridge is still ahead.

exitChoices.label: See the span
exitChoices.description: The rolled row is done and the road continues.

runSteps.title: Roll in the open
runSteps.text: Tell the table this beat is a roll, not a scripted monster. Roll 1d6 where everyone can see it.

runSteps.title: Run only that row
runSteps.text: Read the matching row. If it is the combat row, offer the listed way out before initiative.

runSteps.title: Move on either way
runSteps.text: Success and failure both leave the party able to continue. Do not gate the next scene on this roll.

scenes.advanceWhen: One rolled row has been resolved and the party is moving again.

scenes.title: The Gate Hears the Count
scenes.purpose: Return to Oakhaven and settle the rescue, including the +1 weapon if the people and the span were both saved.
scenes.readAloud: The east gate bench is drier than you left it, which feels like an insult if the gorge is still in your clothes. The sergeant counts people, not planks. She makes a mark for each civilian who walks through, and she does not mark the wagons until the people are done. On the table behind her is a longsword in a plain sheath, city-issue, with a thin line of light along the fuller that ordinary steel does not keep.
gmNotes: People saved are the success, even if the bridge is gone. Say the count out loud.

Best ending (people and bridge): the sword is a +1 longsword. SRD, uncommon, no attunement in SRD 5.2 or SRD 5.1. +1 to attack and damage rolls. Any simple or martial weapon can replace the longsword if the fighter does not want a sword; the bonus stays +1.
If the bridge was lost or the rescue was costly, pay the gold already written and do not give the sword. Series pregens assume the best ending. Tell a drop-in table they may still grant the sword.

runSteps.title: Count the living
runSteps.text: Mark each saved civilian. Do not let the bridge outrank them.

runSteps.title: Pay
runSteps.text: Use the ending's gold. Award the +1 weapon only on the full save.

runSteps.title: Soren
runSteps.text: If he lived, he sleeps on the bench. If he died, the sergeant writes his name and still pays.

scenes.advanceWhen: The survivor count and the payment are written down.

scenes.title: Resolution: The Bell in the Water
scenes.purpose: End the bridge and lead the party to The Bell Beneath the Mere.
scenes.readAloud: Under the pay slate is a ferryman's sounding, still damp. The Night Spring does not stop at the gorge. The line continues into the Mere, and beside it someone has written that a bell is ringing under still water where bells should not ring. The sergeant taps the note. “Noll Vey is hiring. His apprentice went to answer it. That is the next wet job, and it can wait until you are dry.”
gmNotes: Module 06 is level 6. This module was the step from 5 to 6.
The sounding, the pier ash, and Soren's report are three ways to know the Mere is next.
Stop. Do not row onto the Mere tonight.

runSteps.title: Show the line
runSteps.text: Night Spring into the Mere. A bell. A missing apprentice.

runSteps.title: Name the level
runSteps.text: Series characters become level 6.

runSteps.title: Close
runSteps.text: End at the gate.

scenes.advanceWhen: The Mere lead is clear and the session ends.

clues.revelation: The bridge's original ashwood ribs were part of a filtration system for tainted groundwater.
sources: Soren identifies missing ash ribs at the eastern pier.
The ashhouse wall diagram shows ash ribs draining into sacrificial beds.
Charred residue around surviving ribs is clean while black seepage concentrates around iron replacements.

clues.revelation: Iron emergency braces replaced three ash ribs and broke the old filtration function.
sources: The maintenance ledger records three ash ribs removed after flood damage.
Fresh iron braces stand exactly where blackwater now jets from the pier.
Soren's written objection explains that iron could carry load but not absorb seepage.

clues.revelation: Ash-lime mortar can seal the eastern pier and restore enough filtration for the bridge to survive the surge.
sources: The ashhouse maintenance inscription gives the mortar formula: two white measures, one black measure, then water.
A labeled repair bucket reads EAST PIER SEEP SEAL.
Soren explains that the mortar is the last emergency substitute for a missing ash rib.

clues.revelation: The heavy stone wagon accelerates bridge failure and can be dumped quickly.
sources: Soren's physical chalk load record marks the stone wagon as the largest active stress on the center span.
Mera explains the rear pins can dump the stone cargo in one Action.
Visible cracks widen beneath the stone wagon whenever the span shifts.

clues.revelation: The Night Spring continues southeast to a flooded bell chamber beneath the Mere.
sources: Soren's groundwater soundings continue past the bridge toward the Mere.
An old ashhouse survey map labels a downstream anomaly BELL CAVITY.
Blackwater vibration produces a distant bell-like tone from downstream after the pier is sealed.

encounters.name: Blackwater Lampreys
encounters.summary: Two pale lamprey-like scavengers climb the east rail while the party prepares the center span.
encounters.objective: Keep the preparation area clear long enough to set lines or dump cargo.
encounters.resolution: Drive both lampreys into the gorge, defeat them, or ignore them and proceed to the finale.
encounters.talkOut: They are animals and cannot negotiate.
encounters.bypass: An adjacent character can use an Action and DC 12 Strength (Athletics) to shove a lamprey back into the gorge, removing it from the encounter.
encounters.special: They never pursue onto the west bank and are not required kills.

encounters.name: Four Integrity Rescue
encounters.summary: Characters spend limited rounds moving civilians, reducing wagon load, and sealing the eastern pier while the bridge loses integrity.
encounters.objective: Get all six civilians off and either seal the pier or abandon the bridge safely.
encounters.resolution: All civilians safe plus pier sealed or span abandoned.
encounters.talkOut: There is no antagonist to persuade; coordination with Soren and Mera changes action efficiency.
encounters.bypass: A party that abandons the bridge can focus entirely on civilians. Saving infrastructure is optional.
encounters.special: Bridge Integrity decreases only while the pier remains unsealed.

puzzles.name: Three Measures Black
puzzles.prompt: The maintenance verse reads: TWO WHITE TO BIND, ONE BLACK TO DRINK, WATER UNTIL THE TROUGH STANDS STILL.
puzzles.solution: 2 measures lime, 1 measure char ash, then water.
puzzles.failForward: A wrong dry ratio causes Caustic Puff but consumes nothing. After the first mistake, worn scoop marks reveal two white measures and one black.

traps.name: Caustic Puff
traps.trigger: Mix the dry mortar ingredients in the wrong ratio.
traps.effect: The acting creature makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw; failure takes 1d6 poison damage.
traps.failForward: Ingredients remain usable and scoop wear reveals the correct ratio after the first error.

items.name: Bridge Line
items.description: A heavy rope with fixed eye loops.
items.effect: A successful setup grants advantage on civilian crossing checks in the finale.

items.name: Prepared Ash-Lime Seal
items.description: Emergency mortar mixed in the bridge ashhouse.
items.effect: One Action at the eastern pier automatically seals the leak and stops round-end Integrity loss.

items.name: Healer's Satchel
items.description: Medicine cargo awarded if the wagon survives.
items.effect: Contains two separate Potion of Healing doses using the selected ruleset's normal potion rules.

items.name: +1 Longsword
items.description: City-issue steel with a thin line of light along the fuller. Awarded only if the people and the span are both saved.
items.effect: SRD +1 weapon, uncommon. No attunement in SRD 5.2 or SRD 5.1. +1 to attack and damage rolls. Any simple or martial weapon can replace the longsword; the bonus stays +1.

playMaps.title: Ashen Bridge — 100 × 40 ft.
playMaps.caption: Live rescue map with west bank, center wagons, eastern pier, and blackwater gorge.
notes: Eastern pier repair point at east end
Falling into gorge is only possible after rail failure or explicit collapse effect

Verse contains the complete intended solution clue

events.name: Pier Failure
events.trigger: End of each finale round while pierSeal is false

events.name: Pressure Break
events.effect: DC 12 Dexterity save or Prone; loaded stone wagon causes one extra Integrity loss the first time.

endings.name: The Road Holds
endings.condition: All civilians safe, pier sealed, Bridge Integrity above 0.
endings.result: Bridge survives; 125 gp reward; medicine-wagon bonus if saved; Mere lead revealed.

endings.name: People Before Timber
endings.condition: All civilians safe but bridge is abandoned or collapses.
endings.result: Full civilian rescue; 100 gp reward; bridge closed until rebuilt; Mere lead revealed.

endings.name: Hands on the Rope
endings.condition: Integrity reaches 0 while civilians remain, but hanging rescues are completed.
endings.result: Civilians survive with injuries; 75 gp reward; bridge destroyed; Mere lead revealed.

policies: Every clock failure creates a rescue complication before it creates death.
The party can always prioritize people over infrastructure and still earn a successful ending.
Move mechanical information forward through Soren, Mera, visible cracks, or maintenance labels instead of requiring one specific check.

routes.trigger: Soren is refused, missing, unavailable, or incapacitated.
routes.response: His chalk load board, ashhouse key, and maintenance note remain tied to the west milestone. Mera can explain the caravan side of the rescue.
stateChanges: The bridge clock and ashhouse solution remain available.
The party can run the rescue without Soren.

routes.trigger: The party skips or bypasses the Ashhouse and starts the rescue without prepared mortar.
routes.response: The bridge can still be saved with two DC 13 improvised Pier Seal successes, or the party can abandon the structure after evacuating everyone.

routes.trigger: The medicine wagon falls or is deliberately abandoned.
routes.response: No required clue or rescue condition is lost; only the optional Healer's Satchel reward disappears.
stateChanges: Reward decreases only by the optional bonus.

routes.trigger: Bridge Integrity reaches 0 while civilians remain.
routes.response: Remaining civilians make collapse saves and become hanging rescue targets on failures. The party gets a final rescue window instead of instant fatalities.
stateChanges: The adventure remains finishable through hanging rescues.

routes.trigger: The party treats a Blackwater Lamprey or another creature as the apparent antagonist and attacks or kills it before understanding the structural problem.
routes.response: The lamprey fight changes nothing about the bridge truth. Soren's chalk load record, the ashhouse inscription, visible iron braces, and blackwater jets still reveal the failed filtration system and rescue priorities.
stateChanges: Required bridge clues remain physical and available.
Combat never replaces or blocks the rescue objective.

pathPressure.principle: Preparation buys action efficiency; skipping preparation makes the same rescue harder but never locks the ending. The party can still finish by getting the civilians off and abandoning the bridge if necessary.
prepared: Prepared Ash-Lime Seal stops Integrity loss with one Action.
Guide Line grants advantage on civilian crossing checks.
Dumping the stone wagon prevents the one-time Pressure Break integrity penalty.
rushed: Without prepared mortar, sealing requires two DC 13 repair successes.
Without a Guide Line, civilian crossing checks are normal.
Leaving the stone wagon loaded costs an extra Integrity during the first Pressure Break.

cutOrder: If the table is behind, resolve each rolled row in one sentence. Do not skip the return to Oakhaven or the lead into the next module.
If 20+ minutes behind, remove the Blackwater Lampreys and let the party begin scene-span with Mera already holding one end of the guide line.
If 15+ minutes behind in the ashhouse, reveal the scoop wear marks before the first mix.
Never cut the six-person rescue count, the four-integrity clock, or the pier-seal choice.
optionalOrder: Fighting the Blackwater Lampreys instead of shoving/ignoring them.
Saving the medicine wagon after all civilians are already safe.

checks.label: Mix the Ash-Lime Seal
checks.ability: Intelligence (Investigation or Nature) for a hint
checks.success: Confirm 2 lime / 1 char ash / water. Prepared Seal is created.
checks.failure: A wrong ratio causes the listed hazard but ingredients remain; scoop wear reveals the ratio.

checks.label: Set the Guide Line
checks.success: Guide Line is secured; civilian crossing checks gain advantage.
checks.failure: The knot slips; retrying remains possible before or during the finale.

checks.label: Dump the Stone Cargo
checks.success: Cut rear pins; heavy cargo falls clear and the first Pressure Break cannot cause the extra wagon integrity loss.

checks.label: Guide civilians west
checks.failure: Move 1 civilian to safety; progress is never zero.

checks.label: Seal the Eastern Pier
checks.ability: Strength (Athletics), Intelligence (Nature), or Dexterity with suitable tools
checks.success: Without prepared mortar, record one of two required successes. With Prepared Seal, no roll is needed: one Action completes the seal.
checks.failure: No progress this Action; retry next round.

encounters.objective: Keep the center span clear while preparing the evacuation.
encounters.start: Three blackwater lampreys climb the east rail when the party reaches the center wagons.
encounters.bypass: An adjacent creature can use an action and a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check to shove one lamprey into the gorge. DC 15 is this scene's bypass. It is not the grapple escape DC printed on the stat block.

creatures.name: Blackwater Lamprey
creatures.statBlock: SRD Giant Constrictor Snake, reskinned as a blackwater lamprey surging onto the span. Huge. Blindsight 10 ft.
creatures.attack: 2024, confirmed: Bite +6, reach 10 ft., 11 (2d6+4) piercing. Constrict is a Strength save DC 14, 13 (2d8+4) bludgeoning, and Grappled (escape DC 14). 2014 Constrict is an attack roll. The 2014 bite damage and the 2014 escape DC were not re-copied from an SRD 5.1 PDF. Use the 5.1 block if you have it. If you do not, say so and use the 2024 DC 14 save.
creatures.trait: Bypass: an adjacent creature can use an action and a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check to shove one lamprey back into the gorge, removing it. This DC 15 is the scene's bypass, not the grapple escape.
creatures.edition2024: Confirmed SRD 5.2: AC 12, HP 60, speed 30 ft., swim 30 ft. Multiattack: Bite and Constrict. Bite +6, reach 10 ft., 11 (2d6+4) piercing. Constrict: DC 14 Strength save, 13 (2d8+4) bludgeoning and Grappled (escape DC 14).
creatures.tactics: Surge onto the east rail, grapple one isolated person, and drag them toward the edge. A shoved lamprey does not return.

encounters.end: Lampreys are defeated, shoved away, ignored as the finale begins, or the party leaves their reach.
encounters.balance: SRD 5.2.1 for 4 level-5 characters: Low 2000, Moderate 3000, High 4400. Creature XP spent: 1350, below the Low budget. Three CR 2 snakes are still under Low for four level-5 characters. The Integrity clock is the real finale. SRD 5.1 prints monster XP and does not include an encounter-budget table, so this module does not invent a 2014 Easy/Medium/Hard/Deadly label.
encounters.scaling: 3 PCs: 2 lampreys (900 XP) against Low 1500. 5 PCs: 4 lampreys (1800 XP) against Low 2500. 6 PCs: 4 lampreys (1800 XP) against Low 3000.
encounters.balanceWhy: Three CR 2 snakes are still under Low for four level-5 characters. The Integrity clock is the real finale.

encounters.objective: Rescue six civilians and seal or abandon the bridge before structural failure becomes fatal.
encounters.start: Bridge Integrity 4; Civilians 6; Pier Seal false; Pressure Break at initiative 20.
encounters.bypass: The party may ignore bridge preservation entirely and spend actions only on civilians, accepting bridge loss as a successful rescue.
encounters.end: All civilians are safe and the bridge is sealed or abandoned/collapsed.
encounters.scaling: 3 PCs: start Bridge Integrity at 5. 5 PCs: 7 civilians (add a frightened child who needs a separate guide action). 6 PCs: 8 civilians and the first Pressure Break also costs 1 Integrity even if the cargo was dumped.

hazards.trigger: Mix the dry mortar ingredients in the wrong ratio.
hazards.failForward: Ingredients remain and scoop wear reveals the correct ratio.

hazards.save: DC 12 Dexterity saving throw for creatures on the center or eastern span.
hazards.failForward: The first Pressure Break also costs 1 extra Integrity only if the heavy stone cargo was not dumped.

rewards.reward: 125 gp total; if medicine wagon survives, gain two Potion of Healing doses.

rewards.when: All civilians survive but bridge is lost.
rewards.reward: 100 gp total; medicine bonus only if explicitly saved.

rewards.when: Integrity reaches 0 before evacuation completes but hanging rescues succeed.
rewards.reward: 75 gp total; survivors may be injured.
Groundwater soundings reveal a flooded bell chamber beneath the Mere.

features: six civilian start positions around wagons

flowContract.principle: Preparation scene leads into one timed rescue finale with outcome branches based on lives saved and bridge state.

clock.name: Bridge Integrity
states: 4 — span damaged but stable enough for organized rescue
3 — rail joints separate; deck visibly flexes
2 — eastern half sags and wagon wheels roll toward the pier
1 — primary beam splits; only rope and secondary braces remain

rulesEditions.carryForward: Level 5 sheets add the +1 longsword on Calder Voss and still carry the wand, cloak, and pearl.
rulesEditions.unsettled: SRD 5.1 has no encounter-budget table. Boots of Elvenkind attunement in SRD 5.1 was not re-read from a 5.1 PDF. Where a 2014 attack line is not copied, the scene says so and points at the 5.1 stat block.
